Name: Infernal Reinforcement
Components: V, S, M (well-chewed peppermint chewing gum)
Description: A layer of protective shadows covers you. For the duration, you gain a +1 bonus to AC and if a creature hits you with a melee attack, the creature takes 1d4 fire damage. This damage can trigger no more than once per turn.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the fire damage increases by 1d4 for each slot level above 1st.
